name: Blossom Shine - Inspired by Victoria's Secret Bombshell | Radiant Perfume for Women
description: Blossom Shine, inspired by the glamorous Victoria's Secret Bombshell, is a celebration of feminine charm and elegance. This radiant fragrance opens with the sparkling freshness of passionfruit and grapefruit, blending seamlessly into a heart of peony and lily of the valley. As the scent evolves, warm base notes of musk and woody accords add depth and sensuality. With a 40-50% perfume oil concentration, Blossom Shine is crafted to last, keeping you radiant and confident from morning to night. Perfect for women who love to shine in every moment, this scent is your go-to for both casual and special occasions. Features Top Notes: Passionfruit, Grapefruit Heart Notes: Peony, Lily of the Valley Base Notes: Musk, Woody Accords Longevity: 6-8 hours (Moderate to Long-Lasting) Occasion: Perfect for daily wear, dates, and celebratory events Why Choose Blossom Shine? Inspired by the iconic Victoria's Secret Bombshell A luxurious, vibrant fragrance designed for modern women 40-50% perfume oil concentration for extended longevity and projection Exclusively available at Scents by Aamir, blending premium quality with affordability Materials & Care Content: Alcohol-based perfume enriched with high-quality natural oils Care: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight Packaging: Elegantly designed glass bottle, perfect for travel or gifting
